statement: A host with an app serves only credentials that declare that app: another one, or none, is Rejected(APP_MISMATCH) (SCP-11); without a host app the credential's app applies. On a gateway the host app of a route's requests is the route's metadata cosec-app-id, ahead of cosec.authorization.scope.app-id; a cosec-app-id that is not a string (a number, a boolean, a list or a map is not read as its text) or cannot be an app id (SCP-10) fails the request as an unmodelled error (500), never leaves it without a host app.
